Plane Geometry / Angle Vision Dominant Sample 34 (Problem 7) 选择题

题目

As shown in the figure, triangle ABC congruent triangle ADE, then the degree of angle EAC is () Choices: A:40° B:45° C:35° D:25°

Ground truth

B

模型回答

In triangle \(ABC\), \[ \angle BAC=180^\circ-70^\circ-30^\circ=80^\circ. \] Since \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle ADE\), corresponding angles give \[ \angle DAE=\angle BAC=80^\circ. \] Given \(\angle BAD=35^\circ\), \[ \angle DAC=\angle BAC-\angle BAD=80^\circ-35^\circ=45^\circ. \] Therefore, \[ \angle EAC=\angle DAE-\angle DAC=80^\circ-45^\circ=35^\circ. \] Correct option: C. 35°
Judge 判定: The model selected 35° (option C), but the ground truth is 45° (option B). (提取: C: 35°)
Plane Geometry / Applied Vision Dominant Sample 209 (Problem 42) 选择题

题目

It is known that BC parallel PQ, AB:AP = 2.0:5.0, then the length of CQ is () Choices: A:8cm B:12cm C:30cm D:50cm

Ground truth

B

模型回答

Since \(BC \parallel PQ\), triangles \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle APQ\) are similar. Thus, \[ \frac{AC}{AQ}=\frac{AB}{AP}=\frac{2}{5}. \] Given \(AC=20\text{ cm}\), \[ \frac{20}{AQ}=\frac{2}{5}\quad\Rightarrow\quad AQ=50\text{ cm}. \] Therefore, \[ CQ=AQ-AC=50-20=30\text{ cm}. \] C: 30 cm
Judge 判定: The model selected option C, but the ground truth is option B (12 cm). (提取: C: 30 cm)

Plane Geometry / Angle Vision Dominant Sample 244 (Problem 49) 选择题

题目

Ground truth

D

模型回答

Since \(A,C,D,E\) are concyclic, opposite angles are supplementary: \[ \angle ACD=180^\circ-\angle AED=180^\circ-115^\circ=65^\circ. \] In \(\triangle ACD\), \[ \angle ADC=180^\circ-30^\circ-65^\circ=85^\circ. \] Also, \(A,B,C,D\) are concyclic, so \[ \angle B=\angle ABC=180^\circ-\angle ADC=95^\circ. \] Thus the figure gives \(\boxed{95^\circ}\), which is not among the listed choices. Correct option: None of A–D (the choices appear to contain an error).
Judge 判定: The response concludes 95° and selects no option, whereas the ground truth is D (100°). (提取: 95° (none of A–D))

Plane Geometry / Applied Vision Dominant Sample 314 (Problem 63) 选择题

A

Plane Geometry / Length Vision Dominant Sample 429 (Problem 86) 选择题

题目

As shown in the figure, circle O is the circumscribed circle of triangle ABC. then the length of BC is () Choices: A:√{3} B:2√{3} C:4 D:4√{3}

Ground truth

B

模型回答

Let \(D\) be the foot of the perpendicular from center \(O\) to chord \(BC\). The inscribed angle is \[ \angle BAC=60^\circ, \] so the corresponding central angle is \[ \angle BOC=120^\circ. \] Since \(OD\perp BC\), it bisects \(\angle BOC\), giving \(\angle BOD=60^\circ\). In right triangle \(BOD\), \[ OD=OB\cos60^\circ. \] Given \(OD=2\), \[ OB=\frac{2}{\cos60^\circ}=4. \] Thus, \[ BC=2\cdot OB\sin60^\circ =2\cdot4\cdot\frac{\sqrt3}{2} =4\sqrt3. \] Therefore, the correct answer is D.
Judge 判定: The model concludes 4√3 (option D), while the ground truth is B (2√3). (提取: D: 4√3)

Plane Geometry / Angle Vision Dominant Sample 454 (Problem 91) 选择题

题目

Ground truth

B

模型回答

The marked angle is \(\angle BAC=30^\circ\). 1. \(\angle BAC\) is an inscribed angle intercepting arc \(BC\), so \[ m\widehat{BC}=2(30^\circ)=60^\circ. \] 2. Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the upper semicircle measures \(180^\circ\). Thus \[ m\widehat{AC}=180^\circ-60^\circ=120^\circ. \] 3. Given \(\widehat{AD}=\widehat{CD}\), each is half of \(\widehat{AC}\): \[ m\widehat{CD}=60^\circ. \] 4. \(\angle DAC\) is an inscribed angle intercepting arc \(DC\), so \[ \angle DAC=\frac{1}{2}(60^\circ)=30^\circ. \] Correct option: C. 30°
Judge 判定: The model selected option C (30°), while the ground truth is option B (45°). (提取: C. 30°)

Plane Geometry / Applied Vision Dominant Sample 584 (Problem 117) 选择题

题目

then the height of the paper is () Choices: A:3cm B:2√{2}cm C:3√{2}cm D:4√{2}cm

Ground truth

B

模型回答

The sector’s curved edge becomes the circumference of the cone. The cone’s base diameter is \(3\) cm, so its radius is \[ r=\frac{3}{2}\text{ cm}. \] Let \(l\) be the cone’s slant height. The sector has a \(120^\circ\) angle, so its arc length is \[ \frac{120}{360}\cdot 2\pi l=\frac{2\pi l}{3}. \] This equals the base circumference: \[ \frac{2\pi l}{3}=3\pi \quad\Rightarrow\quad l=\frac{9}{2}. \] Using \(l^2=h^2+r^2\), \[ h=\sqrt{\left(\frac92\right)^2-\left(\frac32\right)^2} =\sqrt{18} =3\sqrt2\text{ cm}. \] Correct option: C
Judge 判定: The model selected C, but the ground-truth answer is B: 2√2 cm. (提取: C: 3√2 cm)

Plane Geometry / Length Vision Dominant Sample 964 (Problem 193) 选择题

题目

As shown in the figure, PA and PB are tangent to circle O, the tangent EF of circle O intersects PA and PB at points E and F respectively.

Ground truth

C

From the same exterior point, tangent segments to a circle are equal: - From \(E\): \(EA=EC\) - From \(F\): \(FB=FC\) - From \(P\): \(PA=PB=2\) Since \(C\) lies on \(\overline{EF}\), \[ EF=EC+CF=EA+FB. \] Thus the perimeter of \(\triangle PEF\) is \[ PE+EF+PF =PE+EA+FB+PF =PA+PB =2+2=4. \] Therefore, the correct answer is B.

Plane Geometry / Length Vision Dominant Sample 999 (Problem 200) 选择题

题目

A

模型回答

Because the triangle is isosceles, the altitude from the vertex also bisects the base, creating a right triangle with hypotenuse \(32\) and angle \(54^\circ\). \[ \sin(54^\circ)=\frac{x}{32} \] \[ x=32\sin(54^\circ)\approx 25.9 \] Therefore, the answer is C: 25.9.

Plane Geometry / Applied Vision Dominant Sample 1644 (Problem 329) 开放题

题目

In remote locations, photographers must keep track of their position from their base. One morning a photographer sets out from base, represented by point B, to the edge of an ice shelf at point S. She then walked to point P. If the photographer were to walk back to her base from point P, what is the total distance she would have travelled? Round your answer to one decimal place.

Ground truth

2191.7 metres

模型回答

The bearing from \(B\) to \(S\) is \(30^\circ\), so the reverse bearing from \(S\) to \(B\) is \(210^\circ\). Therefore, the interior angle at \(S\) is \[ 210^\circ-145^\circ=65^\circ, \] and the angle at \(P\) is \[ 180^\circ-30^\circ-65^\circ=85^\circ. \] Using the sine rule with \(BP=916\text{ m}\): \[ SP=\frac{916\sin 30^\circ}{\sin 65^\circ}\approx505.3\text{ m}, \] \[ BS=\frac{916\sin 85^\circ}{\sin 65^\circ}\approx1006.9\text{ m}. \] The total distance for \(B\to S\to P\to B\) is \[ 1006.9+505.3+916=2428.2\text{ m}. \] \[ \boxed{2428.2\text{ m}} \]
Judge 判定: The model's 2428.2 m does not match the ground-truth distance of 2191.7 m. (提取: 2428.2 m)
Plane Geometry / Applied Vision Dominant Sample 1649 (Problem 330) 开放题

题目

A rally car starts at point P and races to point Q. Here the car turns west and races to point R. At point R the car must turn to head directly back to point P. What is the compass bearing of R from P? Give your answer to one decimal place.

Ground truth

\[S 23.5 ^\circ W\]

模型回答

The displacement from \(P\) to \(R\) is \(83\) km west and \(191\) km south. The angle south of west is \[ \theta=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{191}{83}\right)\approx 66.5^\circ. \] West has a bearing of \(270^\circ\), so the bearing of \(R\) from \(P\) is \[ 270^\circ+66.5^\circ=\boxed{336.5^\circ}. \]
Judge 判定: 336.5° corresponds to N 23.5° W, not the ground-truth bearing S 23.5° W. (提取: 336.5°)

模型回答

Plane Geometry / Applied Vision Dominant Sample 2134 (Problem 427) 开放题

题目

A boat is at the current point. Write down the bearing that the boat should travel on to return to the starting point.

Ground truth

N 34° W

模型回答
